snippet.title: Bhimashankar Jyotirlinga | Gupt Bhimashankar | Bhimashankar Temple Tour Guide | Food | Hotels
snippet.description:
Bhimashankar Jyotirlinga Darshana🔱📿🌿✨️

Discover the divine tranquility of Bhimashankar Jyotirlinga, one of the 12 sacred Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva, nestled in the picturesque Sahyadri mountain range of Maharashtra! This ancient shrine, around 110-125 km from Pune, is a blend of spirituality, history, and breathtaking natural beauty.

Bhimashankar is not just a pilgrimage site; it's an immersive experience where lush greenery, dense forests, and the serene Bhima River create a truly mystical atmosphere. The temple's architecture, a mix of old and new Nagara style, showcases intricate carvings and ancient craftsmanship. It's believed that the original Shiva Lingam here is "Swayambhu" (self-manifested).
Beyond the main temple, explore the Bhimashankar Wildlife Sanctuary, home to diverse flora and fauna, including the unique Malabar Giant Squirrel (Shekru). You can also visit nearby attractions like the Ram Temple, Devi Temple, and the mystical Gupt Bhimashankar, believed to be the original source of the Bhima River.

Whether you're seeking spiritual solace, an adventurous trek, or simply a peaceful escape into nature, Bhimashankar offers an unforgettable journey.

snippet.title: First Time in Delhi – Street Food Chaos, Kebabs & Delhi Belly 🤯
snippet.description:
We’ve landed in Delhi, and this was my first time in India—what an incredible, mind-blowing food experience! We explored Old Delhi’s chaotic streets, from Zakir Nagar to bustling roadside stalls, discovering some of the most iconic Delhi street food I’ve ever tasted. This wasn’t just any food vlog—it was a deep dive into authentic Indian street food, from sizzling galouti kebabs and seekh kebabs cooked right on the roadside to rich, velvety nihari stew served in bustling alleyways.

In Zakir Nagar, we found the best nihari in Delhi—a melt-in-your-mouth beef dish bursting with spices and perfectly slow-cooked meat. Just steps away, we stumbled upon skewers of buff kebabs cooked over open flames and packed with bold masala flavors. The seekh kebabs were spicy, aromatic, and unbelievably juicy—this is the true taste of Old Delhi kebabs and authentic Delhi street food.

Then came the big butter chicken battle. We visited both Moti Mahal—the legendary birthplace of butter chicken—and a rival spot also claiming to have invented this iconic dish. We compared traditional butter chicken with creamy, tomato-rich gravy to a modern version with a lighter, smoother texture. Trust me, the debate over the best butter chicken in Delhi is far from over!

The adventure continued with crispy fried chicken from a hidden street stall, rich goat brain curry from Karim’s, and buttery romali rotis that paired perfectly with the bold Delhi street food flavors. We also savored sizzling tandoori chicken, chapli kebabs packed with mint chutney, and a showstopping inverted butter chicken drenched in sizzling butter.

This trip wasn’t just about food—it was a full-on sensory overload. The sounds of the streets, the heat of the Delhi sun, the thick air filled with spices and smoke, and the sheer energy of the people made this Delhi food tour unforgettable. Whether you’re searching for the best butter chicken, rich nihari, or the boldest seekh kebabs in Delhi, this video captures it all.

🎥 Filmed in Delhi, India, 2025—featuring Zakir Nagar nihari, Karim’s goat brain curry, Moti Mahal butter chicken, and the chaos of Old Delhi street food tours.

snippet.title: Baba Baidyanath Dham Darshan & Deoghar Special Maha Prasad PEDA, Jharkhand l Jyotirlinga Temple Ep 1
snippet.description:
Just before the sacred month of Sawan began, we travelled to Deoghar in Jharkhand, home to the Baba Baidyanath Dham, one of the twelve Jyotirlingas and among the most important Shiva shrines in the country. This visit was made possible in collaboration with Trip to Temple, our travel partner for this journey.

We began the day at the temple. First we met one of the main priests. The queues were already building. After a long wait of nearly four to five hours, we finally made it inside for darshan. The experience was powerful, crowds of pilgrims and an atmosphere soaked in chaos and devotion. He then shared stories about the temple’s mythological origins, its connection to Ravana, and why it holds such deep significance for so many. Though Anubhav had visited before, he felt the place revealed something new each time, especially just ahead of the Sawan rush.

Of course, Deoghar is also known for its peda. After the darshan, we made our way to the famous Peda Wali Gali, a bustling street lined with sweet shops stacked with trays of freshly made peda. We stopped at Kanhai Lal and Sons, a shop with a long-standing legacy. A chat with the owner gave us insight into their process, their history, and what makes their peda stand out in a town full of sweet makers.

We ended the day with some much-needed comfort at Awantika, a place known for its Bengali snacks and sweets. This journey, like many others, weaves together food, culture, and lived experience,

snippet.title: Subah 5 Baje Jama Masjid ka Street Food | Chapli Kabab, Lassi aur Kachori Ka Zaika 😋😋
snippet.description:
#jamamasjidstreetfood #streetfood #olddelhi 
Don't forget to subscribe

Dilli ki subah kuch khaas hoti hai, lekin Jama Masjid ke aas-paas ki galiyon mein jab khana banta hai, toh hawaon mein bhi zaika ghul jaata hai. Subah ke 5 baje jab puri Dilli soti hai, yahan zindagi chakhne ke liye jag chuki hoti hai.

⸻

Episode 1: Afghani Samosa Restaurant – Subah ki shuruaat Chapli Kabab ke saath

Subah ki pehli roshni ke saath hi Jama Masjid ke ek kone mein se ek khushbudar dhuaan uthta hai — ye hai Afghani Samosa Restaurant. Yahan ke Chapli Kabab ka jadoo aisa hai ke ek bite lete hi lagta hai jaise Peshawar ki galiyon se Dilli aa gaye ho. Garam, masaledar aur halka crispy — ye kabab subah ke sardi mein ek garmahat le aata hai.

Phir aata hai shawarma roll, jismein chicken ka juicy pan se nikalta mazza aur garlic mayo ka creamy touch milke ek dum behtareen street treat banata hai. Aur unka Afghani chicken samosa — bhai sahab, ismein sirf murgh nahi, mohabbat bhara hota hai. Har ek samosa mein Afghani spices ka asli touch milta hai, jo ise aam samose se kahin upar le jaata hai.

⸻

Episode 2: Kamaal Sweets – Mithaas aur Subah ki Shaan

Thoda aage chalte hi milta hai Kamaal Sweets ki shop, jahan se ghee ki khushboo aati hai jo seedha dil tak jaati hai. Yahan ki sabzi puri ek dum ghar ke taste jaisi — halke masale wali aloo ki sabzi, aur garam, phooli puriyan — aise lagta hai jaise maa ne tiffin mein rakhi ho.

Aur halwa-matri ka combo toh kamaal ka hai! Karare matri ke saath jab suji ka garam halwa milta hai, toh lagta hai jaise Dilli ne apna dil tumhare plate mein rakh diya ho. Subah ka nashta agar Kamaal Sweets ke bina karein, toh woh adhoora lagta hai.

⸻

Episode 3: Mamu Bhanje Ki Khasta Kachori – Ek Purani Dilli ka Zaika

Jama Masjid ke ek dusre mohalle mein milta hai Mamu Bhanje ki Kachori. Naam hi kaafi hai — aur unki khasta kachori waise hi kaafi hai! Har kachori ke andar masaledar daal ki filling hoti hai, aur upar se woh itni karari ki aawaz aapke kaanon mein bajti hai. Sath mein milti hai khatti-meethi chutney aur dahi — bas, subah ban jaati hai.

Mamu bhanje ke thele ke aas-paas hamesha bheed hoti hai, lekin har kisi ke chehre pe ek hi cheez hoti hai — tasalli.

⸻

Episode 4: Mohd Yunus Milk Store – 80 Saal Ki Thandak

Nashta jab ho jaaye, toh kuch meetha-thanda ho jaaye. Uske liye perfect jagah hai Mohd Yunus Milk Store, jo lagbhag 80 saal se Jama Masjid ki galiyon mein apna swad banaye hua hai. Yahan ki dahi ki lassi — bhai, kya kehne!

Ghada mein bani thandi, ghadhi hui lassi jo dahi ke asli swad ko barkarar rakhti hai. Upar se malai ki ek moti layer aur thoda pista — har ghoont mein purani Dilli ka zaika, aur nayi Dilli ka pyaar milta hai.

⸻

Ant mein ek baat:

Jama Masjid ke yeh chhote chhote food joints na sirf khana dete hain, yeh yaadein dete hain. Har nashta, har swaad ek kahaani kehta hai — mohalla, parampara aur pyar ki kahaani.

Agar Dilli ko subah mehsoos karna hai, toh ek din 5 baje Jama Masjid ki galiyon mein zaroor aaiyega.
